Broomfield Election Results: Unofficial Numbers From the Official Source

Unofficial results. Final results are the ones the election authority certifies.

Results

Live results for the Tuesday, November 3, 2026 election load in your browser from Colorado Secretary of State (statewide and federal contests; Broomfield turnout) and change as counting continues. If nothing appears here, the official numbers are linked under Official source below.

Official source

  • Colorado election night results (Secretary of State) (sos.state.co.us)
  • Broomfield-specific contests and ballot questions (City and County of Broomfield) (broomfield.org)

Local Broomfield contests and ballot questions are not in the state's results feed, so they are linked, not copied.
